Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy (indicated by blue arrows) and a reticulo-nodular pattern, which are hallmark features of pulmonary sarcoidosis. Option A correctly identifies these key findings along with nodular opacities in the upper zones, a typical distribution for sarcoidosis, while excluding pleural effusions which are rare in this condition.
